opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grants

amount.raw: up to £200 (Scheme A), up to £500 (Scheme B), up to £750 (co‑sponsored Scheme B), up to £300 (Scheme C)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Genetics Society junior scientist members (undergraduate, MSc and PhD students; postdocs within six years of PhD viva) for Scheme A, and PhD students/postdocs for Schemes B & C. UK‑based members for non‑Society meetings; non‑UK members for UK meetings.
opportunities.summary: Grants to support attendance at Genetics Society meetings, other genetics‑related conferences, or virtual meetings, covering travel, accommodation and registration costs.

opportunities.title: Training Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK, or attending a UK‑based course. Students need a supervisor letter; supervisors must be Society members.
opportunities.summary: Grants of up to £1,200 to support attendance at short genetics‑related training courses or collaborative visits to other laboratories.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK, or intending to carry out fieldwork in the UK. Students need a supervisor letter; supervisors must be Society members.
opportunities.summary: Awards to cover travel, accommodation and related costs for field‑based genetics research projects, with a focus on work suitable for publication in the journal Heredity.

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant
opportunities.summary: Grants up to £1,000 to support public engagement activities related to genetics, covering travel and material costs.

opportunities.title: One‑off Meeting Grant

amount.raw: several hundred to a few thousand pounds (typical £1,000–£2,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society members who wish to organise a genetics‑themed meeting in the UK.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship for genetics‑themed meetings not organised directly by the Society, covering venue, speaker, and Carer’s Award costs.
